entry.title: MPC Commander 1.3.0
entry.summary: The plugins MPC loads, with their own skins, and MPC's transport, in a desktop app (through an SSH tunnel by default). ## Requirements - A Gen2 MPC OS standalone device (aarch64: Live III, One G2, Key(s) G2). The installer refuses anything else. - **Root shell access** (SSH) to the device. Stock MPC OS doesn't offer this; you need a modded unit. - Installing addins this way is unofficial: back up first, use at your own risk. ## Install 1. Unzip, then copy the whole folder to the device, e.g. `sc

entry.title: MPC Commander 1.2.0
entry.summary: ## New in 1.2.0 - **MPC Sample:** the addin runs in the Sample's `MPC Sample` process and finds its settings and open project. - **Browser UI:** the plugins' panels and MPC's transport in a browser, as well as in the desktop app. - **MPC Sample rack** (with mpc-addin-sample-rack): add, remove and turn plugins on or off from the browser. With rack 0.3.0, ON/OFF on a running plugin acts at once (until MPC restarts; Apply writes it into the project). - **Compact parameters:** a Cards/Compact switch

entry.title: MPC Commander 1.1.0
entry.summary: The plugins MPC loads, with their own skins, and MPC's transport, in a desktop app (through an SSH tunnel by default). ## What's new in 1.1.0 - A Gen2 (aarch64) build, alongside the Gen1 (armv7) one (#3). - Preload chaining fix: `dlsym(RTLD_NEXT)` now searches the libraries loaded after the caller first, so Commander sits safely next to other addins that wrap the same functions (#1). ## Requirements - An MPC OS standalone device.
